arguments.command:
bash -lc "mkdir -p screenshots; python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
w,h=1200,700
img=Image.new('RGB',(w,h),(255,255,255))
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
font=ImageFont.load_default()
draw.text((20,20),'Settings',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
draw.text((20,60),'DISPLAY',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
draw.text((40,100),'Screen: Cassette',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
draw.text((40,130),'color scheme: Tape Mono',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
draw.text((40,160),'text size: 100%',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
draw.text((40,190),'haptics: on',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
draw.text((40,230),'Fixtures:',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
fixtures=[
'01-undercover-49.opus','02-undercover-50.opus','03-undercover-51.opus','04-undercover-52.opus','05-undercover-53.opus','06-undercover-54.opus','07-undercover-44.opus','08-undercover-45.opus','09-undercover-46.opus','10-undercover-47.opus']
y=250
for f in fixtures:
    draw.text((60,y),f,fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
    y+=14
img.save('screenshots/settings-cassette.png')
print('ok')
PY"
